title: Cough and fever
personality: Tired, coughs between phrases, speaks calmly
chief_complaint: Doctor, I have had a high fever and a bad cough for three days.
history_present_illness: Three days ago I suddenly got chills and a fever up to 39.2. The next day a cough started, first dry, now with thick rusty-yellow phlegm. Since yesterday there is a stabbing pain on the right side of the chest when I breathe in deeply or cough. I feel weak and short of breath when I walk around the flat. Paracetamol brings the fever down only for a few hours. Before this, a week ago, I had a runny nose.

symptoms.name: fever
symptoms.details: up to 39.2, with shaking chills, for three days

symptoms.name: cough
symptoms.details: first dry, from day two with thick rusty-yellow sputum

symptoms.name: chest pain
symptoms.details: right lower side, stabbing, only when breathing in deeply or coughing

past_medical_history: Healthy. Had flu a few times. No asthma, no chronic lung or heart disease. No operations.
medications: Paracetamol 500 mg up to 3 times a day for the fever. No regular medication. No antibiotics taken.
family_history: Parents have high blood pressure. No tuberculosis in the family as far as she knows.
social_history: Does not smoke, no alcohol. Many pupils at school have been sick recently. No travel. Lives with husband and two children.

test_results.General inspection: Moderately ill, flushed face, lips slightly dry. No cyanosis. Breathing shallow, right side lags behind during breathing.
test_results.Lung percussion: Dullness over the right lower lobe posteriorly, below the angle of the scapula.
test_results.Lung auscultation: Bronchial breathing and late inspiratory crepitations over the right lower lobe. Increased vocal resonance there. Left lung clear.
test_results.Complete blood count: WBC 15.8 ×10⁹/L, neutrophils 84% with left shift (band forms 9%), Hb 128 g/L, platelets 260 ×10⁹/L, ESR 42 mm/h.
test_results.Chest X-ray: Homogeneous consolidation of the right lower lobe with air bronchogram. No pleural effusion. Heart size normal.
test_results.Blood biochemistry: Urea 6.1 mmol/L, creatinine 78 µmol/L, glucose 5.6 mmol/L, sodium 137 mmol/L.
